Name: Dinosaur Replacement - Turtle
Author: HohenHeizen
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/CPslYJw.gif[/img][img]https://imgur.com/2bV9Het.gif[/img]
[size=3][b]DINOSAUR REPLACEMENT - TURTLE/TORTOISE[/b][/size]
   Takes the default dinosaur texture and adds a shell. 
   Changes the name and description of the Dinosaur Egg & Mayonnaise for immersion.
   Based on land tortoise, shell uses colors from the Dinosaur Egg artifact.
   Somewhat retracts into shell during the sit animation. Now with two variations.
   Spines on Dinosaur Hat and named changed removed to make more turtley.
   Turtles can now croak if you wish them to. 
   Should support [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
   Includes Dinosaurless Shell for Self Editing onto Modded sheets.﻿

[size=3][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*] Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*] Unzip the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
[*]﻿ Run the game using SMAPI.
[*] Enjoy Turtles.
[/list]
[b][size=3]CONFIG.JSON:
[code]{
  "Tortoise": "TortoiseNew",
  "Name": "tort",
  "Hat": "true",
  "Croak": "true"
}[/code][/size][/b][u] ﻿Tortoise[/u]: TortoiseNew, TortoiseOld, ShElleTortoise, false
Default: TortoiseNew
Description: Changes texture of the Dinosaur
  
[u]Name[/u]: tort, turt, false
Default: tort
Description: Changes Dinosaur name to Tortoise or Turtle, applies to all occurences in game.
  
﻿[u]Hat[/u]: true, EPS, false
Default: true
Description: Removes spines and changes name of Dinosaur Hat, supports EPS.
  
[u]Croak[/u]: true, false
Default: true
Description: Adds a croak to the Dinosaur to give it more life.
[b][size=3]
